page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is built on the KVM hypervisor and provides 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the instance and external storage or network resources. The absence of local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff that optimizes the instance for pure memory and compute density.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial network capacity, the ecs.r7.32xlarge is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data processing workloads that require massive memory footprints without local storage dependencies.
